sentences.text:
These Writ Petitions Coming On For Preliminary
Hearing In 'B' Group 0This Day, The Court Passed The
Following:
ORDER The petitioners contends that they have established an industry for packaging drinking water after obtaining necessary permission from the Competent Authorities.

The 3rd respondent issued notices at Annexures-Q and Q1 dated 22.3.2012 and 30.3.2012 pointing out certain violations of the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Regulations made therein, while packing the water.
Petitioners have filed objections to the said notices as per Annexure-R dated 17.7.2012.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the 3rd respondent is likely to take coercive steps for closing the industry without considering the representation.

It is further submitted that the point in issue is covered by the decision of the Division Bench of this Court in W.P.Nos.17713/2012 and other connected matters disposed of on 9.11.2012.
3.
It is evident that the petitioners have filed objections to the show cause notices referred to above.
The 3rd respondent has to consider the objections and pass appropriate orders thereon.
Till the consideration of the matter as above, he should not take any coercive steps for closing the industry of the petitioners.
Objections shall be considered and appropriate orders shall be passed within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
Ordered accordingly.
Writ petitions are disposed of accordingly in the aforesaid terms.
No costs.

Sd/-
